home.headline: 자율 AI 에이전트를 위한 실시간 DevOps 컨텍스트.
home.subHeadline: 실시간 클라우드 장애, 엣지 지연 시간, DNS 쿼리 및 SSL 인증서 상태를 Claude와 Cursor로 직접 스트리밍하는 오픈소스 Model Context Protocol(MCP) 서버입니다.

agentDemo.tab1Question: Why is the Next.js production build failing on Vercel?
agentDemo.withoutAction1: Agent inspects local code, guesses syntax issues, and suggests unnecessary refactors to package.json.
agentDemo.withoutResult1: Wasted developer hours rewriting functional code.
agentDemo.withResult1: Agent immediately informs you that Vercel's build queue is degraded. No code changes required.
agentDemo.tab2Question: Is our API domain SSL certificate valid for tomorrow's launch?
agentDemo.withoutAction2: Agent cannot inspect live TLS sockets. Suggests manually installing openssl or checking browser dev tools.
agentDemo.withResult2: Agent verifies TLS certificate chain and confirms the certificate is active through Let's Encrypt.
agentDemo.tab3Question: Did our custom domain CNAME finish propagating?
agentDemo.withoutAction3: Agent suggests waiting 24-48 hours and running local dig commands.
agentDemo.withResult3: Agent queries Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 in 18ms and confirms the CNAME record is globally active.

home.archSubtitle: AI 코딩 도우미가 배포 코드를 작성하기 전에 인프라를 검증하는 데 필요한 모든 기능.
home.outageCardDesc: AWS, Vercel, GitHub의 실시간 상태를 파악하여 타사 장애 중 불필요한 코드 리팩토링을 방지합니다.
home.sslCardDesc: 인증서 만료일 및 발급자 체인을 자율적으로 검증하는 네이티브 TLS 핸드셰이크 도구.
home.dnsCardDesc: 라우팅 및 레코드 전파를 디버깅하기 위한 실시간 DNS-over-HTTPS 쿼리(A, AAAA, CNAME, MX).
home.pingCardDesc: 전 세계 엔드포인트 응답 시간, 헤더 및 상태 코드를 테스트하는 가상 HTTP 프로브.
home.setupDesc: MCP 설정 파일에 SSE 엔드포인트를 추가하세요. API 키나 인증이 필요하지 않습니다.

features.title: Live Cloud Telemetry Features
features.subtitle: Discover the powerful DevOps capabilities WolrdPulse exposes to AI coding agents.
features.statusDesc: Fetches live operational status and incident reports for AWS, Cloudflare, GitHub, OpenAI, Vercel, and more.
features.sslDesc: Inspects SSL certificates to verify expiration dates and issuer chains.
features.dnsDesc: Resolves DNS records securely via Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 without exposing your local DNS cache.
features.pingDesc: Sends synthetic HTTP probes to test edge latency and retrieve response headers.
features.pulseDesc: Aggregates engineering blogs and news to give agents context on latest framework updates.
features.mcpToolsSub: Connect your IDE agent to https://wolrdpulse.app/sse to expose these tools automatically.
features.faqDesc: Direct answers to common questions about WolrdPulse, MCP integration, and live telemetry.
features.faq1Q: How does WolrdPulse MCP eliminate AI hallucinations during cloud outages?
features.faq1A: WolrdPulse provides autonomous coding agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf) with live telemetry from AWS, Vercel, and GitHub via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). When a build fails due to a third-party cloud degradation, the agent queries WolrdPulse, detects the active incident in sub-50ms, and notifies the developer immediately instead of rewriting functional code.
features.faq2Q: How do I connect Claude Desktop or Cursor to WolrdPulse?
features.faq2A: Add the SSE endpoint https://wolrdpulse.app/sse to your claude_desktop_config.json or cursor_mcp.json under the mcpServers block. No API keys or authentication are required.
features.faq3Q: What makes WolrdPulse different from standard uptime monitors?
features.faq3A: Traditional uptime checkers only alert humans via email or Slack. WolrdPulse formats cloud telemetry into native JSON-RPC Model Context Protocol tools that AI models can autonomously invoke during agentic pair programming to check network sockets, TLS certificates, and DNS records.
features.faq4Q: Which DNS and SSL verification tools are supported?
features.faq4A: WolrdPulse supports live DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) queries for A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, and CAA records via Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, as well as native TLS socket handshakes to verify SSL certificate issuer chains and expiration dates.

developer.title: About the Developer | Anas Rhimi (WolrdPulse)
developer.description: DevOps & Cloud Engineer behind WolrdPulse, an open-source MCP telemetry server for AI coding agents.
developer.descriptionDetailed: Building open-source infrastructure and AI agent telemetry. Focused on eliminating expensive enterprise SaaS paywalls for developers worldwide.
developer.whyBuiltP1: When working with autonomous coding agents like Claude Desktop and Cursor, I noticed a constant blind spot:
developer.whyBuiltStrong: AI 에이전트는 실시간 클라우드 인프라 상태를 전혀 알지 못합니다
developer.whyBuiltP2: . If a CI/CD build fails, an API route times out, or a DNS record hasn't propagated yet, the AI agent will assume there is a bug in the code and start suggesting unnecessary refactors—completely unaware that AWS or Vercel is simply experiencing an outage.
developer.whyBuiltP3: I built WolrdPulse as a free, lightweight Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that runs on global edge infrastructure. It gives your AI tools instant, live diagnostics—status feeds, DNS lookups, latency tests, and SSL verification—in real time without requiring hundreds of dollars in proprietary SaaS subscriptions.
developer.archTechDesc: Designed for sub-50ms tool execution and zero-dependency integration.
developer.mcpStandardDesc: Standard JSON-RPC over Server-Sent Events (SSE) for 1-click integration with Claude, Cursor, and custom agent loops.
developer.globalEdgeDesc: Queries Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS (1.1.1.1) and native Node TLS sockets to test endpoints in milliseconds.
developer.freeOpenDesc: MIT Licensed. Publicly accessible endpoints with no API keys, accounts, or telemetry tracking required.
developer.sponsorProjectDesc: WolrdPulse is 100% free and maintained in my free time. If this tool saves your team money or improves your AI development workflow, consider supporting the project on GitHub Sponsors.
developer.sponsorGithubDesc: Support open-source DevOps and AI telemetry tools

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Desc: WolrdPulse is designed as a stateless Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. We do not require account creation, and we do not collect, store, or sell any personally identifiable information (PII) from the AI agents or users connecting to our endpoints.
privacy.section2Desc1: When your agent connects to the WolrdPulse SSE endpoint (
privacy.section2Desc2: ), we may log basic connection metadata (e.g., IP address, connection duration, and request volume) strictly for the purpose of maintaining service reliability, rate limiting, and preventing abuse.
privacy.section3Desc: WolrdPulse aggregates data from third-party APIs (such as AWS, Vercel, and GitHub). When you or your agent requests data, no user-specific information is passed to these underlying services. We simply fetch public status endpoints and proxy the results.
privacy.section4Desc1: If you have any questions regarding this privacy policy or how WolrdPulse handles data, please contact the developer at
